i_want: to browse a list of restaurants
so_that: I can find a suitable place to order food from
acceptance_criteria: The list of restaurants is displayed on the app interface.
Users can filter restaurants by cuisine type.

i_want: to place an order by selecting items from the menu
so_that: I can get my desired food delivered to me
acceptance_criteria: Users can view a menu of items offered by a restaurant.
Users can add items to their cart.
Users can provide custom instructions for their orders and receive a notification if their instructions exceed character limits before submission.

i_want: to track my delivery status in real-time
so_that: I can know when to expect my food
acceptance_criteria: Users can view the delivery status on the app.
The delivery status updates every minute.
The app must function effectively, requiring reliable GPS and network connectivity.

i_want: to rate and review my experience after delivery
so_that: I can provide feedback to help improve the service
acceptance_criteria: Users can provide a rating for the overall experience.
Users can write a review from a text box.
User data privacy must be maintained, and content moderation must be in place for reviews.

so_that: I can easily access them for future orders
acceptance_criteria: Users can mark restaurants as favorites.
Users can access their list of favorite restaurants quickly.
Users should be able to unsave a restaurant from their favorites list at any time.

i_want: to quickly reorder from my saved favorites
so_that: I can save time when ordering food
acceptance_criteria: Users can select a favorite restaurant to make an order.
Users are directed to the menu of the saved favorite restaurant upon selection.
